discrepancies.what: NRM changes relations.add as well as relations.mul: the g2 skip also drops add(0, x), and 4*g1 becomes two additions, so CAND does #pairs-with-disc - #g2-skips more additions (net +1 per pair with g3 != 0). PROTOCOL H_nrm allows relations.add to change; the count identity holds exactly.

H_nrm says points are normalised with first coordinate 1; points with first coordinate 0 exist (56 residual points at production sizes; 134 fb pairs and 158 residual points in the small-q sweep). The code tests the operand at run time, so they take the counted path; verified exact.

The NRM saving is the removal of products whose operand is the constant 1 (five sites) and of the product by the constant 4 (one site, replaced by two additions). These are real operations of the REF code path that CAND no longer executes, not a re-pricing; but they are baseline waste rather than a new algorithmic idea. At w_add = 1 the 4*g1 rewrite costs one M-eq more than it saves; the ratio stays < 1 because of the other five sites.

LZ_REUSE does not touch DL (block Lanczos): LZ/REF for DL is exactly 1 at every cell, and the DL headline (BOTH) equals NRM alone. DL1 is cheaper than DL in this model at k = 22 already in REF (5.264e8 vs 8.440e8 M-eq at w = 0; 2.226e9 vs 2.544e9 at w = 1); the frozen band anchors only REF DL, so DL1's IC/rho (0.00116 / 0.00125 / 0.00143) uses the same rho but has no previously validated REF anchor; its records were replayed here (all sampled units) like DL's.
PROTOCOL.md reports a main-session pilot (q 262111 and 1048507, seed 1) before the freeze, which informed the predictions; the decision rule does not use the predictions.

null_object_control: The claim is a deterministic counted-work ratio, not a statistical signal; there is no parameter whose increase should destroy it. Nulls of the same shape: (a) A0 (CAND, no env) = REF in every counted field on all 30 producer cells and 2 replayed units, ratio exactly 1; (b) LZ on the untouched DL arm gives exactly 1.000 at every cell, w_add and w_h (predicted negative case); (c) the oracle shows every skipped operand equals 1 and every reused dot equals the direct dot; (d) three mutants that make one skip or reuse inexact are all detected (6/6 runs). Mechanism check in place of a decay parameter: the LZ saving per call is (I-1)(2n-2)-1 lmul against matvec work growing with nnz, so its share should be larger after SGE (DL1: lmul ratio 0.784 -> 0.762 from k = 18 to 22) than on the full matrix (D: 0.981 -> 0.983) - observed.

None found.

No extrapolation is claimed.

limitations: L0: session container (4 vCPU), up to 3 units concurrent; only counted fields are claimed and compared. No EKS route, no native L2/replay/A/A admission; no wall-clock claim.

Scope: GHS-weak family E0/F_{q^3}, driver ic <q> <seed> D 3.0 1.7, k = 18..22, seeds 1-6 (producer), seeds 10 and 11, one c_D = 1.55 unit and q 223..32719 (validator). Transfer beyond these instances rests on the identity proofs, not on measurement.

The rho side is the frozen band; no rho was re-measured. The band prices additions at 0; with additions priced the IC side rises (w_add = 1 values are in tables.md) while the rho side was not re-priced.
Counted-cost improvement of 1.3-4.3% (DL) and 5.6-16.5% (DL1) depending on w_add; NRM is a removal of trivial products (N3).
Independence is of reasoning and code within the same session family and host; no keyring signature.
method: scripts/: select_units.py (nonce sample, written before the nonce), make_plan.py, make_plan2.py, replay.sh, make_oracle.py (oracle build), make_mutants.py (negative controls), lzstress.rs (stress harness), compare_replay.py, compare_plan2.py, recompute.py (headline from the producer tarball), make_reports.py (this file and the certificate).
